steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What colors might be used to add an accent, highlight, and outline to the groundTile asset?


Solution:

Additional details should be added to the groundTile asset: speckled white and teal pixels should be added throughout the tile (to match the ones on the dirt tiles), a tan highlight and a light purple outline should be added across the top of the tile. The tiles should update automatically on the tilemap.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might you add a curved line on the leftCurvedTile asset?

Solution:

The leftCurvedTile asset should be updated so that the top left pixels are removed, then tan (highlight) and light purple (outline) pixels should be connected diagonally to create a curved line. The asset should be duplicated, then horizontally flipped to create a rightCurvedTile asset. rightCurvedTiles should be added to the appropriate spots on the tilemap.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ What function checks if a tile image matches the tile next to a sprite?

Solution:

Inside the up and down button pressed events, if conditionals should be added with a tileKindAt function inside. The function’s parameters should be set to TileDirection.Center, assets.tile`ladderTile`
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code and tile assets to create a working project!


The ground tiles should match the appearance of the dirt tiles, but also include an outline and highlight to show that it is the “top” of the ground.


The edges of the hill tiles should be curved in the appropriate directions.


The Player sprite’s climbing animation should run only when it is climbing up or down a ladder.


Use the tools in the tile editor to modify each tile asset and the functions in the code menu to create a working version of this project!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 8 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original tile assets to build unique tilemaps. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 8:

badges.title: Mapping It Out
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original tile assets that can be used for top-down or 2D tilemaps.

badges.title: A Whole New World
badges.description: Create original tile assets, including ground terrain and floating platform tiles, that can be used to design a 2D tilemap.

badges.title: Open Concept
badges.description: Create original tile assets that can be combined in a variety of ways to design structures that span multiple tiles.

badges.title: Changing It Up
badges.description: Change a sprite’s movement ability based on its location in relation to a specific tile kind.
